note_tweet.text:
Claude Duet is Anthropic's always-on agent bet

Anthropic opened a Claude Duet research preview on Claude Opus 5.5 — iOS, Android, and web. US Pro and Max can waitlist; Team and Enterprise are out. It runs on a cloud VM with a browser and 6,000+ connectors (Gmail, Slack, Stripe), so it keeps working while you are offline.

Here's the thing: Grok Bot shipped in August, Meta Muse and OpenAI Dots in September. Duet is that race with a tighter leash — morning brief, then pings only when a decision is needed. Payments, messages, signatures, deletes wait for a yes. Bank transfers and trades stay blocked. It polls every few hours because those checks burn the same Claude usage cap.

Always-on agents are shipping. The kill switch is the product.

#Anthropic #ClaudeDuet #AIAgents

I've been able to shift about 90% of my work as a solo founder to be entirely through my phone by changing just one thing.

✅ Adding an always-on agent that sits between me and my workflow.

It took just a couple days of training it on my critical management functions and then things started to become magical.

Spinning up new CLI sessions, restarting them, keeping contexts clean, handing off work between, approving things, keeping teammates moving along, etc., all become out of sight and out of mind.

I was able to use my newfound hours in the day to focus more on marketing and distribution.

I now have a much healthier balance between the two domains, which I believe will make my projects stand a much better chance of success as a single solo founder trying to do EVERYTHING.

I truly believe that we'll see a $1B company with a single employee within the next year (followed by one with zero employees the year after).

I just hope that whoever benefits from that achievement end up doing a whole lot of good for the world.

That's truly the point of it all, right??

Make the world a better place.

Anywho, here's my high-level stack that's super simple for you to setup in just an hour or so:

Muse -> Tailscale -> Laptop Terminal -> Claude/Gemini session management (via detached tmux containers)

I chose Muse because of the timing and their super generous free usage.

I've only ever hit the weekly limit once and usage only spilled over by 1% (and pulled from the 4B free promo tokens I have built up from referring friends)

Use code "EK52PB" and we both get another 1B more free tokens 🤜🤛

It's now absolutely crazy to think how much time I was spending managing multiple coding agent sessions, keeping context windows clean, and merging PR's.

Cheers all!
